title: GPTで先に演者に必要な動き（演者の所作・アクション）を作ってからSeedance2.5用のストーリーボードを組む
content:
GPTで先に演者に必要な動き（演者の所作・アクション）を作ってからSeedance2.5用のストーリーボードを組む  
ClaudeのHTMLで画像付きストーリーボードを作成しPNGに書き出して、Seedance2.5に添付して動画生成する  
Seedance2.5で作る動画をKlingでリップシンクする場合は、顔がはっきり認識できる映像にし、口が閉じているカットを減らして反映率を上げる

en.content:
GPT first creates the necessary movements for the performer (gestures and actions), and then a storyboard for Seedance2.5 is assembled.  
Using Claude’s HTML, an image-based storyboard is created and exported as PNG, then attached to Seedance2.5 to generate the video.  
If you want to lip-sync a video made with Seedance2.5 in Kling, make sure the face is clearly recognizable in the footage, and reduce the number of cuts where the mouth is closed to improve the success rate.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I tried turning rakugo into a rap MV using generative AI.  
I was shocked that I could make an MV with just 5 black-and-white storyboard panels.

Music: suno  
Video generation: seedance2.5, runway

Storyboard in the replies ↓ https://t.co/PORw1024cC

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] What’s different from the original Inoue Shokudō is:

Instead of an AI-generated storyboard, I first created the movements needed by the performer with GPT,

then turned it into an image-based storyboard in Claude’s HTML and exported it as PNG.

Once it’s in PNG form, you can just attach it to seedance2.5 and turn it into a video, which is personally easier for me.

The difficult part was:

↓ continued https://t.co/PMZ1MnJR7j

[Thread 2] The lip-syncing with Kling.

If the face isn’t clearly recognized, Kling won’t apply the lip-sync properly.

There are also about three places in the video where the mouth is closed, and that’s the reason.

Since there’s music, I thought it would feel like an MV and people wouldn’t mind too much, so I went ahead and posted it. https://t.co/mJciE7F1lt

用 Claude 的 HTML 制作带图片的 storyboard，并导出为 PNG，附加到 Seedance2.5 中生成视频  
如果要用 Kling 对 Seedance2.5 制作的视频做 lip sync，需要让画面中的脸部清晰可识别，并尽量减少嘴巴闭合的镜头，以提高反映率

再用 Claude 的 HTML 做成带图片的 storyboard，并将其导出为 PNG。
